text: I think I have just the thing for you! This Tex-Mex Layered Dip recipe is a great fit for your dietary preferences and goals. As a vegetarian, you'll be happy to know that it's free from animal products, and the bean dip and guacamole will provide a good source of protein to help you meet your health goal. Plus, it's quick and easy to make, taking only about 10 minutes to prepare, which fits within your time budget.
